idea-plugin.name: JVM Beacon
idea-plugin.description:
JMX & JFR diagnostics in IntelliJ IDEA.

Connect to a running JVM, inspect an MBean, follow a live trend, investigate platform threads, and explore a Flight Recorder capture in one native workbench.

  • Search MBeans, read individual attributes, inspect structured values, invoke exposed operations with confirmation, and receive notifications.
  • Follow JVM metrics, inspect platform threads and lock chains, compare snapshots, and save diagnostic evidence locally.
  • Capture bounded JFR recordings and explore sampled stacks, GC, allocation samples and recorded waits with a shared time range.

No cloud account, AI service or plugin telemetry. Credentials use IDEA PasswordSafe. Diagnostic files are not automatically redacted. Platform-thread snapshots do not cover virtual threads.

For IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 and later, with no fixed upper IDE version limit. Release candidate; a declared range does not mean every IDE or future release has been tested. Thread snapshots cover platform threads; JFR analysis describes recorded events and applies explicit file and retention limits.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0-rc.3: broader IntelliJ IDEA compatibility.

  • Allow IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 and later without a fixed upper build limit.
  • Compile against the oldest supported platform and verify selected older and newer IDEs.
  • Skip the build tool's optional online update notice to avoid network stalls.
